title: Extension proof index
statement: For a Boolean circuit $C$, let $V$ be its quadratic variable count and let $P=V+2^V+2^{V^2}$ be its quadratic proof length. Each index $i$ among the $V$ extension-proof positions is sent to position $i$ in the full proof, occupying its initial block of $V$ positions.
